coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed all 12 targeted searches across the four audited high-value miss classes. No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was found in the search window. Surfaced results were stale, historical, outside-window, or non-qualifying, including older sole/full-service grocery closures, prior pantry closures, historical weather-related distribution disruptions, and older SNAP/WIC interruption coverage. Production collection remains authoritative. No approval, publication, schedule change, or task disablement was performed.
